claim_scope: Translation classes of initially periodic integer configurations for labelled simple cycles of every order at least three. Exact transfer, quartic reduction and asymptotic periodic point growth.
limitations: Periodic-point counts exclude transient attraction basins.
Quotient is by common integral translation only, not by rotation/reflection.
Historical-priority search is bounded and cannot exclude every unindexed result.
scientific_integrity: Self-contained proof of exact two-step-return counts and asymptotic. Standard graph diffusion period-at-most-two theorem is cited, not represented as new. Direct dynamics and independent transfer/Newton checks replayed. No external mathematical validation.
title: Quartic transfer and square-root periodic-point growth for cyclic diffusion
